name: deeperas
description: Clarify intent, verify facts, and refuse premature answers.

interface.shortDescription: One useful question at a time. Clearer answers.
interface.longDescription: Resolve material choices with one explained option menu at a time. Preserve context and check available evidence before answering. The X and List shorthand controls are available in ChatGPT only; natural-language requests work across hosts.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Deeperas to clarify the choices that matter before answering.
